主要内容: The Walt Disney Company extended the expiration date of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations for 21CFA Notes from March 14, 2019, to March 15, 2019. The extension is conditional on the closing of New Disney’s acquisition of 21CF, which may not be waived. Settlement is expected to occur promptly after the Expiration Date, but no earlier than two business days, and is tied to the closing of the Acquisition, expected in the first half of 2019. If the Acquisition is not completed, the 21CFA Notes will be returned to holders. The process is governed by the offering memorandum and consent solicitation statement dated October 5, 2018, with amendments and press releases up to March 5, 2019. The extension aims to facilitate proposed amendments to the indentures governing the 21CFA Notes.
